headline: Spot Taker Buying On OKX Rose To 252.259 BTC From 97.996 BTC
narrative: Aggressive buyers on the OKX bitcoin spot market outpaced sellers by 252.259 BTC over the latest day, up from 97.996 BTC. The pipe measures aggressive buy volume minus aggressive sell volume on OKX spot, a proxy for who is lifting offers, not a cross-venue tape and not passive fills. The 252.259 BTC lead ranks in the 76.3 percentile of 24-hour windows over 30 days, up from the 61.6 percentile.
author: jordan
